text:
That day, I walked in for a teeth cleaning. The cost was 1300 baht. The dentist was very meticulous, which I really appreciated, but it was also very painful and caused a lot of tooth sensitivity. The dentist kept trying to comfort me, but it didn't really calm me down because the instruments in her hands were still working in my mouth! 55555 I just endured it and told myself, "It'll pass."

• The clinic was clean, quiet, and peaceful. The only sounds were the instruments and the dentist's voice while I waited.

• The work area was quite disorganized, even though the dentist requested a later time. I think the assistant could have managed and cleaned this area better to accommodate the next client (like me).

• The petite female staff member provided excellent service, spoke politely, and was enthusiastic about her work. This was great. The male staff member in the scrubs didn't smile or anything; he seemed tense, making me feel uncomfortable while waiting.

• I usually have a regular clinic, but due to my busy schedule, I decided to try this one. The dentist was so kind as to offer to adjust my retainer when she found out I hadn't been able to see my regular dentist in February.
